summary: Frontend-only verification of redesigned Super Admin 'Commission & Refund' page (/admin?tab=category_commission) and global admin typography (html.admin-ds). All testids from the spec are present and wired to the right APIs. Verified: page load, 4 stat cards match GET /api/admin/category-commissions (7 total / 3 configured / 4 pending / 65.33% avg partner at start), info banner, red config alert, search (plumb -> 1 row), filters All/Configured/Rate Required reorder & switch style to #0D47A1, Sort dropdown with 4 options, Bulk Configure drawer with cc-bulk-picker preselecting all 3 unconfigured, Configure Now switches filter to Rate Required and opens drawer with first unconfigured category (Appliance Repair). CommissionDrawer: all 6 inputs (cc-partner_pct, cc-platform_pct, cc-merchant_partner_referral_pct, cc-merchant_customer_pct, cc-customer_refund_pct, cc-partner_cancellation_pct) accept decimals; cc-comm-total and cc-canc-total switch green at 100% / red otherwise; live calc cc-sim-partner_pct = ₹700 when amount=1000, 70%; cc-save disabled when any total != 100 and enabled when both totals = 100; save shows cc-save-success overlay, closes drawer, table/stats refresh (Rate Required -> 3 after single, -> 0 after bulk). Policy section: cc-policy-customer-edit and cc-policy-partner-edit open 'Platform Default Split' drawer (PUT /api/admin/settings {commission}). Export (cc-export) downloads commission-by-category-2026-10-03.csv. Cancellation Reasons: add/edit/toggle/delete with confirm all persist via PUT /api/admin/settings; inactive reasons are excluded from GET /api/site/config.cancellation_reasons but kept in settings.cancellation_reasons_meta with active=false. Mobile 390: rows render as cards (cc-list has 7 children), drawer takes full width (390px), no document horizontal overflow. Spot-checked Dashboard, Bookings, Services, Partners and General Settings at 1920 — html.admin-ds is applied on all admin pages with no page-level horizontal overflow. Customer site (/) does NOT carry the admin-ds class (removed on unmount). Original 6 cancellation reasons restored after testing.
critical_code_review_comments: CategoryCommissions.jsx is a thin orchestrator (64 lines) splitting into HeaderStats/CategoryTable/CommissionDrawer/PolicySection/CancellationReasons — good separation; no file exceeds the 700-line guideline.
CancellationReasons.persist() does optimistic update with rollback on error (toast via errMsg) — handled correctly.

CommissionDrawer.save() in 'single' mode optionally does a follow-up POST /bulk when 'Also apply to' is picked; both calls run sequentially — consider wrapping in a single bulk payload server-side to avoid partial-success state if the second request fails (minor; not reproduced here).

In Bulk mode, when 'Select all' is toggled off and then re-toggled while opening the picker, scroll-into-view may miss on narrow drawer at 1920 because overlay disables scroll; not blocking (user picks via per-row cc-apply-{id}).
COMM.k='merchant_customer_pct' uses teal #14B8A6; label on live-calc 'Merchant · Customer' is clear. Picker legend inside the drawer uses the same color map — consistent.

success_rate.backend: n/a (frontend-only run; API calls under test all returned 2xx)
